name: kozo-framework
description: 🔥 The Structure for the Edge - Zero-boilerplate framework on Hono

scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/auth/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/queue/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/redis/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/testing/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/testing/type-tests/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p examples/contract-showcase/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @kozojs/cli build && node packages/cli/lib/index.js check --root examples/contract-showcase && node packages/cli/lib/index.js check --root templates/api-contract && node scripts/check-template-quality.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check
